summary.en: Structural egress firewall: turns away image, file and audio parts, encoded blobs and models outside the allowlist whenever magpie cannot mask the content locally, and fails closed on anything it cannot inspect.
summary.zh: 结构化出口防火墙：凡是 magpie 无法在本地掩码的图片、文件与音频内容、编码数据块，以及不在允许列表中的模型，一律拒绝；无法检查的内容按失败关闭处理。
